source_text: Ὁ τὴν σώφρονα ἐκβάλλων δίδωσιν αὐτῇ ἄδειαν ἄλλῳ γαμηθῆναι, ὅπερ ἐστὶν εἶδος μοιχείας ὡσανεὶ μὴ λυθείσης συζυγίας· οὐ γὰρ τὰ ῥεπούδια παρὰ θεῷ λύει τὸν γάμον, ἀλλ' ἡ ἄτοπος πρᾶξις.
pass_a_gloss: The the sober woman casting-out gives to her license to another to be-married, which is a form of adultery as-if not having-been-loosed the yoking; for not the divorce-papers beside God loose the marriage, but the improper deed.
pass_b_english: The one who casts out a chaste wife gives her leave to marry another — a form of adultery, as if the yoking were not loosed. For divorce papers do not loose marriage before God; improper deed does.

choices.why: Certificate does not dissolve before God.
